title: OSINT Analyst
description:
Full job description

OSINT Analyst

About the role

We are looking for a highly analytical and proactive OSINT Analyst with a strong interest in international affairs, geopolitics, and global energy markets. The successful candidate will monitor and analyze geopolitical developments worldwide, particularly in the Middle East and Africa, to identify emerging risks and assess their potential impact on global oil and gas prices. This role goes beyond following the news. We are looking for someone who can connect geopolitical events, identify early warning signals, anticipate potential developments, and translate intelligence into actionable energy market insights.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor international news, political developments, conflicts, sanctions, and security situations, particularly in the Middle East and Europe.
  • Conduct market research, industry analysis and competitor intelligence.
  • Track relevant companies, sectors, markets and emerging business opportunities.
  • Collect, verify, and analyze information from open sources, international media, government publications, industry reports, and social media.
  • Identify emerging risks, trends, anomalies and significant developments.
  • Produce weekly intelligence reports and monthly market assessments.
  • Assess the potential impact of geopolitical developments on global energy markets and crude oil prices.
  • Use AI and research tools responsibly to improve efficiency and information coverage.

Required qualifications and skills

  • Background in International Relations, Political Science, Economics, Intelligence Studies, or related fields (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Strong research, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Good understanding of international geopolitics, especially the Middle East and Europe.
  • Experience in OSINT, geopolitical risk analysis, or energy research is preferred.
  • Familiarity with international news sources, company databases, public records and economic data.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to summarise complex developments for business leaders.
  • Arabic or French language skills are an advantage.
